qc.label_under_test: the pieces 'aring'/'ared'/'ptic' after the ' se' prefix token (searing, seared, septic)

neighbours.label: word-ending pieces split off a short start (se|aring, se|ared, ne|ared, we|arily, bere|aved, se|ptic), plus the token ' wake'; whole-word tokens like scared, nearing, wearing stay quiet
fire: The searing heat of the desert afternoon made the travelers stop under a rock ledge.
She seared the steaks in a hot cast-iron pan before moving them to the oven.
As the ship neared the harbor, the passengers crowded onto the deck.
He climbed the last flight of stairs wearily and dropped onto the couch.
The bereaved family gathered quietly at the small chapel on Sunday.
The wound had turned septic, so the doctor ordered stronger antibiotics.
Please wake me up at six tomorrow so I don't miss the train.
A searing pain shot through his ankle when he stepped off the curb.
quiet: The scared travelers stopped under a rock ledge during the desert storm.
She cooked the steaks in a hot cast-iron pan before moving them to the oven.
As the ship was nearing the harbor, the passengers crowded onto the deck.
He climbed the last flight of stairs slowly and dropped onto the couch.
The grieving family gathered quietly at the small chapel on Sunday.
The wound had become infected, so the doctor ordered stronger antibiotics.
Please call me at six tomorrow so I don't miss the train.
A sharp pain shot through his ankle when he stepped off the curb.

predictions: expect 8/8 fire at or above 0.2 of max, near misses under 0.1; the risk is the weaker 'wearily' and 'wake' items
